$comment: A laptop's index settings: the file index-initiatives in the record checkout, beside the .env whose
RECORD_FACTORY names the factory its rows are filed under. record's deploy/lodestar/install.sh checks both
and renders the index job's plist from them (RECORD_FACTORY, RECORD_INITIATIVES); deploy/lodestar/index.sh
reads the list on every pass. Built by hestia's card index-plist-versioned (record 81d4051, map L2).
Ruled by Pablo 2026-10-25 (decisions.md, 'every contract between two repos has one shared sample both sides test').
Every reader below reads this file by path and fails, never skips, when it is absent (README rule 3).
A change edits this file first; then every reader and writer listed follows in the same change.

writers.path: the installer that lays a laptop's record checkout down

writers.side: the operator's hand (odyssey's move, the command index-plist-versioned printed)

readers.side: record install.sh (check_list, the factory checks, render)
readers.test: record internal/contracts/indexinitiatives_test.go TestInstallReadsIndexInitiatives (renders every case with install.sh render; valid exit 0 with the plist's keys, must_refuse exit 2 saying why)

readers.side: record index.sh (the job's loop: `while read -r id root cell`)
readers.test: none yet: index.sh runs the index role through docker compose; the valid cases' initiatives are what its loop makes of each line

file.name: index-initiatives
file.factory_from: .env RECORD_FACTORY (the one key read from it; plain, export or quoted; the last one wins)
file.line: id root [cell], separated by spaces or tabs
file.skipped: a blank line, or one whose first non-space character is #
file.cell: optional: the mailbox cell whose threads index-workingon also reads
file.absent: index.sh's own list, lodestar's; then RECORD_FACTORY is unset or lodestar

valid.name: comments, blank lines, tabs and runs of spaces
no list and no factory: index.sh's own list, filed as lodestar

must_refuse.name: four fields
must_refuse.reason: a fourth field would fall into index.sh's cell

must_refuse.name: a list without a factory
must_refuse.reason: its rows would be filed as lodestar

must_refuse.name: a factory other than lodestar without a list
must_refuse.reason: index.sh's own list is lodestar's; odyssey would index lodestar's initiatives

must_refuse.name: a factory that is not a factory name

cases_note: factory "" is a checkout with no .env; lines null is a checkout with no index-initiatives, [] an empty file. A refused case exits 2 and writes nothing; its says is a part of the message.
